info.name: Stedi Healthcare Claims Claim acknowledgments Payers API

params.name: stediId
params.description:
The Stedi payer ID, a unique identifier Stedi assigns to each payer that will never change. You can find the Stedi payer ID for any supported payer in the [Payer Network](https://www.stedi.com/healthcare/network).

This must be the Stedi payer ID - querying with the primary payer ID or payer ID aliases isn't supported.

items.docs: Retrieve a single payer record by its Stedi payer ID.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of elements to return per page. If not set, Stedi returns all payers in a single response (no pagination).

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The `nextPageToken` value from a previous response. You can use this to get the next page of results. If not set, Stedi returns the first page of results.

items.docs: List Stedi's supported payers in JSON format

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of elements to return in a page. If not specified, the default is 20.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: An opaque token returned by a previous call to this endpoint in the `nextPageToken` property. You can use it to request the next page of results. If not specified, Stedi returns the first page of results.

params.name: query
params.description: The query Stedi will use to search the Payer Network database. You can supply a payer's name, ID, or alias. The query is case-insensitive, and fuzzy matching is supported. For example, `cig`, `62308`, and `SX071` all return Cigna in the results. If not provided, the other search options are used to conduct the search.

params.name: eligibilityCheck
params.description: Filter for matching payers with the specified 270 eligibility checks support. When combined with other transaction filters, payers must satisfy **all** specified criteria to be included in results.

params.name: claimStatus
params.description: Filter for matching payers with the specified 276/277 real-time claim status checks support. When combined with other transaction filters, payers must satisfy **all** specified criteria to be included in results.

params.name: professionalClaimSubmission
params.description: Filter for matching payers with the specified 837 professional claims support. When combined with other transaction filters, payers must satisfy **all** specified criteria to be included in results.

params.name: dentalClaimSubmission
params.description: Filter for matching payers with the specified 837 dental claims support. When combined with other transaction filters, payers must satisfy **all** specified criteria to be included in results.

params.name: institutionalClaimSubmission
params.description: Filter for matching payers with the specified 837 institutional claims support. When combined with other transaction filters, payers must satisfy **all** specified criteria to be included in results.

params.name: claimPayment
params.description: Filter for matching payers with the specified 835 Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA) support. When combined with other transaction filters, payers must satisfy **all** specified criteria to be included in results.

params.name: coordinationOfBenefits
params.description: Filter for matching payers with the specified coordination of benefits (COB) checks support. When combined with other transaction filters, payers must satisfy **all** specified criteria to be included in results.

params.name: unsolicitedClaimAttachment
params.description: Filter for matching payers with the specified unsolicited 275 claim attachments support. When combined with other transaction filters, payers must satisfy **all** specified criteria to be included in results.

params.name: coverageTypes
params.description:
Filter for matching payers that support transactions for **all** of the specified coverage types. For example, setting this array to `["medical", "dental"]` returns only payers who provide both medical and dental coverage.

The results also exclude payers without coverage type classifications in Stedi's database.

params.name: operatingStates
params.description:
Filter for matching payers that operate in **all** of the specified states. For example, setting this array to `["CA", "OR"]` returns only payers that operate in both California and Oregon, and setting it to `["NATIONAL"]` returns payers that operate throughout the entire United States.

The results also exclude payers without operating state classifications in Stedi's database.
